definitions.explanation: A quality of grace, tastefulness, or class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Food product safety has become an issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}て→組み立て：08645_kumitate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This product has many parts, so assembly is difficult.
They are a person of refinement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品|ひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She speaks in a refined manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦おいしい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧⟦し→し：noentry⟧、{品|ひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}っている→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧。
examples.english: That restaurant has delicious food and a refined atmosphere, so I like it.

notes:
Has two distinct usages: as a suffix for goods/items, and as a standalone word meaning elegance.

AS SUFFIX (goods):
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food products)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (merchandise)
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (manufactured goods)
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (parts, components)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (work, creation)

AS STANDALONE (elegance):
- {品|ひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have refinement)
- {品|ひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (refined, classy)
- {品|ひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (lacking refinement, vulgar)
- {品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ (to lower one's dignity)

USAGE:
- When read as しな, it typically means "item, article" in a more concrete sense
